nodes.question: Has the mug identified in the source image been moved to the right of the corresponding headphones in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass if comparison of the source and edited images establishes that the source mug has been relocated and is visibly to the right of the corresponding headphones. A different or additional mug on the right does not establish satisfaction. Fail if the source mug is identifiable in the edited image and has not been moved to the right of the headphones. Return unknown if the mug's identity, relocation, or relative position cannot be established reliably; do not infer failure solely from ambiguous correspondence.
nodes.binding: Track the blue handled mug initially left of the black over-ear headphones in the SOURCE image to its corresponding object in the EDITED image, using visible appearance, shape, handle, and scene correspondence. Compare that mug with the edited counterpart of the source headphones. Consider all candidate mugs and the blurred blue shape at the original location; do not select the far-right mug merely because its position fits the request.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source blue handled mug is clearly left of the black headphones. In the edited image, a blurred blue shape remains near the original left-side location, while two distinct mugs are visible elsewhere: a small light-colored mug near the headphones and a blue-gray mug at the far right. The source mug cannot be reliably matched to either visible mug or the blurred shape, so its relocation and position relative to the corresponding headphones are not established.
